question: Identify the most suitable title for the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is The Saga of the Siddis.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage provides detailed information about the Dhamaal traditions and the Siddis of Gujarat.
 
• It covers their musical and dance practices, spiritual leaders, and historical migration.
 
• The title "**The Saga of the Siddis**" appropriately captures the essence of the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **What’s Missing in Dhamaal?** - This title does not fit the informative nature of the passage.
 
• **Wonders of Indian Dance** - This title is too broad and does not specifically relate to the Siddis and their traditions.
 
• **The Bhavnagar Treat** - This title is not relevant to the entire content of the passage.
